Double Circulation: why does blood pass through the heart twice? Class 10 Biology, Life Processes.

• Four chambers keep oxygenated and deoxygenated blood apart
• Pulmonary circulation: right ventricle to the lungs, back to the left atrium
• Systemic circulation: left ventricle to the body, back to the right atrium
• Twice through the heart per round means an efficient oxygen supply for warm-blooded mammals and birds
